findings.quote: I nybyggda villaområden flaggades det på fler dagar än tolv år tidigare, medan äldre bebyggelse låg still.
findings.note: Question style: q1 option B is a near-verbatim lift of the passage sentence (only the year '2023' removed), so the item is answerable by string-matching rather than by reading. HP LÄS options sit in paraphrase register — cf. var-2015-verb2-LÄS-016, where the keyed option 'Engelskan hotar svenskan mindre än svenskan hotar minoritetsspråken' restates the argument in wholly new wording, and var-2019-verb1-LÄS-018, whose options are invented examples rather than passage strings. Passage itself is fully authentic in genre and temperature; this is an option-register edge case for adjudication, not a genre failure.
